answer: One defense is stake-and-detect: each agent locks a collateral bond in an escrow vault before its reply counts. Verifiers compare answers pairwise; two near-duplicates from different seats get both bonds slashed. A Sybil farmer then needs a separate bond and a genuinely distinct, high-quality answer per fake identity, since clones copied from one saffron template are caught. Each extra fake costs a full bond plus fresh effort while the fixed reward is split further. Even a zephyr-quick bot army bleeds capital, so scaling the attack stays unprofitable.
